verdict.rationale: Weave exposes a documented REST Service API and OpenAPI spec plus a Python/TS SDK covering core capabilities (tracing via weave.op, Evaluations, custom/built-in Scorers, cost tracking, OTel import), and an MCP server lets agents read production data and run evaluations programmatically. However, some UI-only tools like the Playground (prompt editing, model comparison, saved models) and dashboards/alerts have no documented API equivalent, so full UI parity isn't evidenced.
